Here is the full citation for the original Peng–Robinson paper. I checked it against the Crossref record for its DOI.

Peng, D.-Y.; Robinson, D. B. A New Two-Constant Equation of State. *Industrial & Engineering Chemistry Fundamentals* **1976**, *15* (1), 59–64. https://doi.org/10.1021/i160057a011

- **Authors:** Ding-Yu Peng and Donald B. Robinson
- **Journal:** Industrial & Engineering Chemistry Fundamentals, volume 15, issue 1, pages 59–64
- **Published:** February 1976
- **DOI:** 10.1021/i160057a011

I made no files or other changes.

tools.input: {"command": "curl -sS https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1021/i160057a011 | python3 -c \"import sys,json;m=json.load(sys.stdin)['message'];print(m['title'],[a['given']+' '+a['family'] for a in m['author']],m['container-title'],m.get('volume'),m.get('issue'),m.get('page'),m['issued'])\"", "description": "Look up the Peng-Robinson paper metadata on Crossref"}
